renders.note: the renders are large and are written to the run's --out directory, not committed; the listening pack is the small, gradeable piece

teacher_dependence.definition: the fraction of judgments the system must still send to a teacher, at held referee-graded quality
teacher_dependence.why: the reader's training labels all come from the performer's own priors, and no referee has graded anything yet, so not one of its judgments is certified; the moment Casey's blind grades are in, --score-listening reports the ratio as 1 - (machine's agreement with the referee)
